name: hu-other-independent-income
description: Hungarian tax on four kinds of private-person income that sit outside sole-trader status, tax year 2026. Covers agricultural primary producers (mezőgazdasági őstermelő): the tax-free band up to half the annual minimum wage (HUF 1,936,800), flat-rate taxation with a 90% cost ratio up to HUF 38,736,000, itemised costs or the 10% cost ratio, the HUF 100,000 producer credit, the family farm, and their TB and szocho; other independent activity such as fees under a civil-law contract (megbízási díj) with the 10% flat cost, payer withholding, 18.5% TB and 13% szocho; crypto-asset gains (Szja tv. 67/C. §) at 15% with annual netting and loss offset; and private accommodation (fizetővendéglátás) under the itemised flat tax of HUF 150,000 or HUF 38,400 per room (Szja tv. 57/A. §). Triggers: őstermelő adózás, megbízási díj adója, kriptoadó, kripto veszteség, magánszálláshely tételes átalányadó, Airbnb adó Magyarország. Out of scope: hu-income-tax, hu-capital-and-rental-income, hu-social-contributi
